response.overview: To dispute an Xfinity charge over the phone, call (1) 866-465-1426 for the billing dispute desk, or log a claim via get help. Have your statement date and exact charge amount ready for a fast credit review.  What to prepare before you reach out  Having these details ready speeds up verification and cuts repeat transfers:  * Your Xfinity account number and billing statement date  * Exact line-item label and dollar amount of the disputed charge  * UPS tracking receipt, store return slip, or promo confirmation email  * Prior support ticket IDs if the charge followed a service visit  Four steps to dispute an Xfinity charge by phone  1. Start by phone: Call (1) 866-465-1426 and give your account number, statement date, and the exact dollar figure you are disputing.  2.
